name: Appliance fault and error codes
description: Error/fault codes displayed by major home appliances (dishwashers, washing machines), with the manufacturer, appliance type, code, and what the code means. The question an assistant gets wrong is what a specific error code on a specific appliance brand means.
licence: factual compilation from manufacturer and independent sources
